auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_003
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic'
  AND b.XCL_006 = 'double'
GROUP BY a.XCL_003
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1
